# LabOS (Protocol Labs Directory)

> LabOS is the Protocol Labs network directory: teams, members, projects, jobs, and Spotlight pitch pages for network companies.

LabOS helps network members discover teams and people, and hosts time-boxed Spotlight pages where teams present to investors.

Important notes:

- Public pages include teams, members, projects, jobs, and Spotlight teasers (title, status, statement).
- Full Spotlight pitch content (deck, profile details, video) requires a LabOS login.
- Auth-gated areas: /deals, /founder-guides, /investors, and most settings.

## Directory

- [Teams](https://directory.plnetwork.io/teams): Browse network teams
- [Members](https://directory.plnetwork.io/members): Browse network members
- [Projects](https://directory.plnetwork.io/projects): Browse projects
- [Jobs](https://directory.plnetwork.io/jobs): Open roles in the network
- [Home](https://directory.plnetwork.io/home): Network home and news

## Spotlight

Spotlight pages live at `/spotlight/{slug}`. Shared links are the primary discovery path.

Public (no login) on each Spotlight page:

- Title, description, spotlight statement, team name, and status (DRAFT / OPEN / CLOSED)
- HTML metadata and JSON-LD for agents and crawlers

For machine-readable link health checks (no HTML parsing):

- [Spotlight status API](https://directory.plnetwork.io/api/spotlight/{slug}/status): Returns `{ slug, status, title, teamName, teamUid, loginRequired, isOpen, url }`

Replace `{slug}` with the Spotlight slug from the shared URL.

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://directory.plnetwork.io/robots.txt): Crawl policy
- [sitemap.xml](https://directory.plnetwork.io/sitemap.xml): Indexable URL inventory
